zh.title: FTAI 向 WestJet 收購 27 架 737-700　17 架回租、10 架納入航太產品業務
zh.summary: FTAI 表示，這是公司歷來規模最大的交易之一，資產將分別進入租賃與零組件供應體系。
body: FTAI Aviation 於 2026 年 9 月 28 日宣布，向 WestJet 收購 27 架 Boeing 737-700。當中 17 架由 WestJet 繼續承租，另 10 架無租約飛機將納入 FTAI Aerospace Products 業務。
17 架帶租約飛機將由 FTAI 在 2026 年成立的特殊目的載具收購，採售後回租結構。10 架無租約飛機則可作為零組件、發動機與維修供應體系的資產來源。
FTAI 稱本案是公司歷來最大型交易之一，但公告未揭露收購價格，也未逐架公布交割日期。交易規模不等同 27 架飛機會同時退出 WestJet 營運。

en.title: FTAI acquires 27 Boeing 737-700s from WestJet
en.summary: Seventeen aircraft will remain leased to WestJet, while ten off-lease jets will enter FTAI's Aerospace Products business.
body: FTAI Aviation announced on September 28, 2026 that it had acquired 27 Boeing 737-700 aircraft from WestJet. Seventeen will remain on lease to WestJet, while ten off-lease aircraft will be allocated to FTAI's Aerospace Products business.

The 17 leased aircraft will be acquired through a special-purpose vehicle established by FTAI in 2026 in a sale-and-leaseback structure. The ten off-lease aircraft can supply assets to the company's components, engines and maintenance ecosystem.

FTAI described the purchase as one of the largest transactions in its history, but did not disclose the price or a delivery schedule for each aircraft. The portfolio transaction does not mean all 27 jets will leave WestJet service at once.

facts.claim: FTAI acquired 27 Boeing 737-700 aircraft from WestJet.
Seventeen aircraft remain leased to WestJet through FTAI's 2026 SPV and ten off-lease aircraft go to Aerospace Products.
FTAI called it one of its largest transactions and did not disclose the purchase price.
